text:
frank: quick heads-up  seeing an uptick in 504s from eu-west1 inference pool since 11:02 UTC. suspect recent cache alloc change in v3.2.1. propose micro-revert image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-microrevert and expedited canary.
meera: paste one-line log and rollback plan pls. canary size suggestion?
frank: log:
```
2026-06-01T11:03:10Z inference-3 error: prefix_cache_alloc > cap -> reclaim -> timeout 504
```
rollback: pin to v3.2.0, cordon & drain new nodes, redeploy previous image; runbook RB-901 referenced. propose 2-node canary in eu-west1, 15m watch then 50% for 10m. disable autoscaler on canary and set mem limit back to 7Gi.
meera: CI smoke ok on image. I approve canary. tagging oncall. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: @frank assigned to oncall until 2026-06-01T15:00Z. Hooks enabled: high-5xx-rate, p99-latency.
deploybot: Deploy requested by frank -> eu-west1 canary (2 instances) image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-microrevert. Observing 15m.
(deploybot) 11:18 UTC: canary 2/2 ready, healthchecks OK, 5xx trending down.
meera: good. watching p95/p99.
11:34 UTC - deploybot: 15m observation complete. canary stable. meera: authorize ramp to 50% for 10m.
deploybot: Ramping to 50% in eu-west1; monitoring.
11:45 UTC - deploybot: 10m complete. metrics: 5xx down ~90%, latency stable, no OOM traces.
frank: proceeding to full rollout with 10m final watch. release note draft: "v3.2.1-microrevert: revert cache allocation bump causing intermittent 504s in EU; no API changes."
releasebot: Reminder: add entry to internal changelog before closing thread.
deploybot: Full rollout complete in eu-west1. Tag: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-microrevert. No alerts during watch windows.
frank: created follow-up RB-901 to add CI/integration tests for prefix-cache changes. marking resolved after changelog entry.
releasebot: changelog updated. thread RESOLVED.
